name: Thumbmagic
description_en:
Thumbmagic makes thumbnail concepts from a video, script or YouTube URL, with templates, text and expression-editing controls. It is intended to prepare and compare visual candidates for video platforms.

The official pricing link leads to a Thumbmagic page on app.submagic.co. This proves the linked purchase route, not a corporate ownership relationship. Click-through and viral-growth promises remain vendor claims rather than measured results.
description_zh:
Thumbmagic 从视频、脚本或 YouTube URL 制作缩略图概念，有模板、文字和表情编辑，便于准备并比较候选。

官方价格链接通往 app.submagic.co 的 Thumbmagic 页面，证明购买路径而非公司所有权关系。点击及爆款增长均为厂商主张，非测量结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Use an authorized video/script to identify visual hooks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用授权视频/脚本识别视觉重点。

core_features.explanation_en: Prepare multiple layouts and review their message and face details.
core_features.explanation_zh: 准备多版式并核信息及面孔细节。

en: Prepare truthful tutorial thumbnail alternatives and inspect small-size readability.
zh: 准备真实教程缩略图版本并核小尺寸可读性。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm the linked plan, use an owned video/avatar and inspect claims, expression, text and downloaded size.
steps.zh: 确认链接套餐，使用自有视频/头像，核主张、表情、文字及下载尺寸。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual-billed thumbnail/avatar tiers; trial limited to three outputs.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual equivalents Starter $17/month/100 thumbnails/one avatar, Pro $35/500/up to ten, Business $59/unlimited claim. Three card-free tries; thirty-day refund advertised. Actual promo, renewal and fair-use terms unknown.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年付折月 Starter $17/100图/1头像，Pro $35/500/最多10，Business $59称不限。3次免卡试及30天退款宣传，促销/续费/合理使用未知。

sources.title: Thumbmagic - The #1 AI Thumbnail Maker for YouTube
sources.research_notes_en: Video/URL-to-thumbnail creation, template/expression editing and variations; CTR/viral outcome claims not verified.

sources.title: Thumbmagic
sources.research_notes_en: Official pricing link goes to app.submagic.co thumbnail-generator route; three free tries, annual equivalents $17/$35/$59 and thumbnail/avatar limits.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Make the thumbnail match the actual video
sections.title_zh: 让缩略图对应真实视频
sections.en: For an illustrative tutorial, show the actual topic and outcome rather than a fabricated before/after. Check facial expression, visible text and object details against the source. A stronger visual hook can misrepresent the video if generation invents an event. Preview at small display sizes as well as full resolution.
sections.zh: 例如教程，应展示真实主题和结果，不编前后对比。核表情、文字及物体与源一致，视觉更强也可能编事件而误导，需小屏及全尺寸预览。

sections.title_zh: 匹配缩略图及头像额度
sections.en: Annual-billed Starter is $17/month with one hundred thumbnails/month and one avatar; Pro $35 with five hundred and up to ten avatars; Business $59 advertises unlimited thumbnails/avatars. The app page offers three free thumbnails without a card and a thirty-day money-back statement. The homepage advertises a different annual promotion; actual checkout and fair-use conditions need confirmation.
sections.zh: 年付折月 Starter $17、月100图/1头像，Pro $35、500图/最多10头像，Business $59 称图/头像不限。应用页送3免费图无需卡及30天退款说法；首页另有不同年促，需核真实结算及合理使用条件。

sections.title_en: A/B candidates are not measured performance
sections.title_zh: A/B 候选不是测得绩效
sections.en: Generate alternatives that differ in one important idea and keep the title/video context consistent when evaluating. A tool’s testimonial or average CTR claim cannot predict your audience. Listed two-/four-times speed tiers are not measured here. No thumbnail was published or audience experiment run; platform acceptance and export dimensions still need validation.
sections.zh: 评估版本时应只变一个重点并保持标题/视频上下文一致。客户评价或平均 CTR 不能预测本受众，2/4倍速度未测。本文未发布或做受众实验，平台接受及导出尺寸仍需核。

sections.title_en: Check upload permissions and export before scaling
sections.title_zh: 扩大前核上传权限及导出
sections.en: Evaluate with your own video and authorized avatar. Inspect any transcript-derived text and ensure generated expressions are appropriate and truthful. No URL import, video upload, avatar, template replication, export or billing was executed. Storage, training use, commercial output rights and the precise relationship with Submagic remain unverified.
sections.zh: 应用本人视频及授权头像评估，核转录文字和表情是否适当真实。本文未导 URL、上传、生成头像、复制模板、导出或付款，存储、训练、商用及 Submagic 精确关系未核。

research_gaps: Pricing source is linked app.submagic.co route; corporate ownership not established.
No generation, CTR, URL/video import, avatar, export, refund, data terms, output license or self-hosting tested.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
